decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 17 July 2006, the erection of roof dormer extension and installation of roof lights, as shown on drawing numbers 0601-EX-01, 0601-EX-02, 0601-EX-03, 0601-EX-04, 0601-EX-05, 0601-EX-06, 0601-PR-01, 0601-PR-02, 0601-PR-03, 0601-PR-04 and 0601-PR-06, received 17 July 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed extensions consisting of a roof dormer extension, and installation of roof lights, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1,Class B and Class C, of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - Informatives: 
1. The proposed roof extension would only be lawful if it was completed prior to any other extensions to the house that would result in the cubic volume of the original house being increased by a total of more than 50m3.
2. The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.
3. The proposed roof lights should be installed flush with the existing roof.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a rear roof extension with roof windows to front elevation to house.
